_comment: Brotli byte budget for each extension's production file (packages/<name>/dist/<file>.min.js.br, the manifest output with minify: true). scripts/test-extension.cjs compares the built file against its number here as the size leg, and fails it when the file is over. The only way past a failure is to raise the number here, in the same change as the code that needed it, with `since` and `why` filled in, so every raise sits in a commit diff beside its cause. When a file lands more than 200 B under budget the leg prints the new floor; lower the budget to accept the win. Kept at the root, not in each package.json, because npm publishes every package.json whatever `files` says, and this is the repo's process, not the user's. Until 2026-10-28 each budget lived in its package.json as wildflower.budget; the earlier raises and their reasons are in that file's git history.

kinetic.why: +29 B (measured 72801 B): the VERSION constant at 0.1.2, Brotli's own variation on a one-character change. Before that, 72772 (2026-11-01 captions() balances its lines): +287 B (measured 72772 B): captions() splits each run of words between forced breaks into the fewest lines maxWords and maxChars allow, as near equal in length as they can be, preferring a break after a clause's end. Before that, 72485 (2026-11-01 text() takes any axis the outlines hold): +6 B (measured 72485 B): text()'s line and letter values accept any axis the outlines were baked with, by its tag (such as Shantell Sans's BNCE), beside wght and slnt. Before that, 72479 (2026-11-01 a page's own sound button, Chrome 157's canvas painting, KN-131 on a page opened from disk): +42 B (measured 72479 B): config({ sound: true }) from a click resumes the audio and the speaker leaves it on; a canvas copy's bitmap is its content box from Chrome 157 (CONTENT_BOX_PAINT); KN-131's sentence names a page opened from disk (development builds). Before that, 72437 (2026-10-31 every footage seek waits for a presented frame; the dust drawn on the CPU): +41 B (measured 72437 B): every footage seek, not only one onto the end of the file, settles once the element has presented a frame, and the finish's dust canvas is created willReadFrequently so a repeated frame draws the same pixels in Chrome; the VERSION constant at 0.1.0. Before that, 72396 (2026-10-28 an end-of-file footage seek waits for a presented frame): +90 B over the 72306 B build before it (measured 72396 B): a footage seek onto the end of its file settles once the element has presented a frame (requestVideoFrameCallback) as well as ended, since ended reads only the position. Before that, +193 B (measured 72364 B): an image still loading after 30 s fails readiness (KN-182), a footage seek not landed in 30 s is KN-138, the clock's seek fails on a media hook's rejection, and config() reports the finish as named parts. Before that, +672 B (measured 72171 B) for the review's low findings, +3 B (71499 B) for KN-192 in the code table, +564 B (71496 B) for the review's high and medium findings; each raise's full list of causes, and every raise before them, is in the git history of packages/kinetic/package.json.

three.why: +79 B over 7183 (measured 7262 B): uniform() returns a function that stops it, sets a number into a Color target and settles a typed-array target of another length; view.draw() inside a frame does nothing, with the 3D-115 warning in development builds. Before that, +180 B over 7003: video(texture), a texture of a <video> uploaded on the next frame after the video's currentTime moves (not while it seeks or has no frame) and drawn under render: 'change', with the function that stops it, the store's method, the clean-up on dispose, and the 3D-114 check and message. Before that, +11 B over 6992: projectPoint(x, y, z, camera) projects through a given camera, and the store's method passes it on. Before that, +481 B over 6511: quaternion and rotation (Euler) fields through three.js's own Quaternion and Matrix4.compose(), a per-axis scale on every way of setting the rotation, quaternion offsets in buffer(), and projectPoint() bringing the camera's matrices up to date, 324 B; the 3D-104 and 3D-105 checks of the new array fields 81 B, and of quaternion or rotation beside another rotation field 76 B, each measured as what the min build loses when it alone is taken out. Before that, 6511: first budget, set at the 2026-10-08 build

threads.since: 2026-10-29 a raw-field write schedules a patch
threads.why: +33 B over the 7779 B first budget (measured 7812 B): an accessor on each raw field sends a write made outside a message or a tick
